Applications

Building Permit Applications are now accepted on regular paper. All signatures are required on application at the time of drop-off. Please do not leave blank checks with your applications.

Permits for small projects, such as roofing, siding, insulation, kitchen and bath remodel, may be paid for up-front.

Solar companies and large firms: please remember to have a local contact number so that we may contact you with questions when your permit has been issued. All solar permit applications MUST go to the Fire Department before the Building Department.
